plan.goal: Retrieve reviewed UniProt sequences annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0034023) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0034021) molecular functions; perform per-residue biochemical analysis and motif detection on each activity class; generate ESM3 sequence, structure, and embedding tracks for representative sequences via foreach fan-out; and produce two ranked candidate lists — one per activity class — to identify the most informative representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair protein research.
assumptions: GO:0034023 (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase) and GO:0034021 (NADPHX epimerase) are the correct standard GO molecular function terms for the two catalytic activities of the NAD(P)HX repair system.
Reviewed Swiss-Prot entries are required; IEA evidence codes are excluded to focus on experimentally supported or manually curated associations, maximising annotation quality for downstream analysis.

Capping at 100 reviewed sequences per GO class covers current annotation breadth; sequence_analysis internally selects a diversity-maximised representative subset from the full FASTA for ESM3 and ranking.
ESM3 is run with sequence, structure, and embedding tracks to capture structural plausibility and latent-space position for each representative sequence.

Two independent rank_designs nodes produce per-class ranked lists; together they span the full NAD(P)HX repair protein candidate space without requiring cross-class array merging in the reference language.
Literature search results provide mechanistic and functional context used in final response interpretation; they are not fed as runtime inputs to downstream nodes.
If a GO term returns zero reviewed sequences the sequence_analysis and esm3_reps nodes for that class will not execute; the workflow remains partially executable for the other class.
representative_sequences from sequence_analysis are objects containing at minimum a sequence field compatible with ESM3 foreach item references.
missing_inputs: Taxonomic scope or organism filter — assumed broad cross-kingdom retrieval with no taxon_id applied.
Desired number of representative sequences per class — defaulting to sequence_analysis internal diversity-based selection.
Ranking criteria weights — rank_designs will apply its default multi-metric scoring heuristics.

success_criteria.sequence_retrieval: At least one reviewed sequence retrieved for each of GO:0034023 and GO:0034021 from UniProt.
success_criteria.analysis_coverage: Biochemical metrics, charge profile, motif/region annotations, and representative_sequences populated for both activity classes in sequence_analysis outputs.
success_criteria.esm3_enrichment: Per-residue embeddings and predicted structures generated for representative sequences of each activity class via foreach fan-out.
success_criteria.ranked_output: Two ranked_candidates lists (dehydratase class and epimerase class), each with top_k=10 entries, providing ranked sequence evidence for a final Reason/Answer response on NAD(P)HX repair protein sequence selection.
